title: Make the documented workflow tests run the local verify step and require it before the scoped review (#906)
description: Make the documented workflow tests run the local verify step and require it before the scoped review (#906)
no_spec_change_rationale: A documentation test and one landing-page line; no module contract, export or requirement changes
acceptance_criteria: In the README and landing-page workflow tests, a prose step naming the verify lane runs the fixture lane (specsync check --strict), which must pass, on the current tip; change review is allowed only after that ran on the tip it reviews (DOCS-2, #906).

The tests fail if a documented closeout drops its verify step or puts it before change check --commit or after change review: the README with its verify line removed fails at the review, and the landing page fails at 3758d970 because it has none.

The landing page closeout gains the verify step after change check --commit, worded like the README (run the local verify lane; CI does not test a tip whose change is still open), and its test passes.
No assertion of the existing documented-workflow tests is loosened.
